violations.description: General employee practices. — --Food employee in bakery observed wearing jewelry on arms during food preparation.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Piping insulation near bakery hand sink torn/damaged and needs repair. Exposed insulation.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor needs cleaning under cabinets in bakery area. Debris build up along floor/wall junctures.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Clean, proper use, storage, sanitizing solution (2 pts deducted)
Available, adequate capacity, able to maintain proper temperature (4 pts deducted)

Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
